_comment: Downstream overrides for ENGINE features, keyed by engine feature id: { "<engine feature id>": { "status": "hidden|disabled|forked", "note": "why, and where the fork lives" } }. A downstream (rekstrarkerfid, LedgerLink, icelandicstore, hallismiley) records here which inherited features it hides, switches off or has forked, so features can be identified across repos without editing the engine's features/*.md (those arrive by merge). This file is product-owned (listed in .engine-paths); in the engine itself it stays empty. tests/unit/featureRegistry.test.js checks every key is an engine feature id.
